title: Shalmaneser I
summary: King of Assyria, identified by CFAH with the "Assyrian Belus".
description: King of Assyria, identified by CFAH with the "Assyrian Belus". Person record added by the CFAH pass for CFAH's reign dates; dates are as printed in the CFAH paper cited.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year.

reign.citation: Griffith & White, "Chronological Framework of Ancient History. 5: The Babylonian Dynasties of Berossus," ARJ 16 (2023): 635–670, section "AP-35: Fall of Akkad to the Guti Arabs: 1477/1476 B.C."
reign.note: "The Assyrian Belus began to reign in 1261, as did Shalmaneser I" (AP-36 is on the event assyrian-belus-shalmaneser-i).

reign.date: Column: Assyrian King List; Name row (Year BC): 1262; Last regnal-year row (Year BC): 1233 (year 30)
reign.citation: Griffith & White, "CFAH-14: Ancient Assyria," OSF preprint v1.0 (27 Feb 2026), doi:10.17605/OSF.IO/9FUW2, file CFAH-14_Assyria_v_1.0.pdf, Table 5 "CFAH Reconstructed Eponym List (CFAH-REL)", pp. 43–45
reign.note: Row "Shalmaneser I" of Table 5 (Assyria). Year-by-year table (1262-963 BC). A ruler's name is printed in one year row and his regnal-year numbers in the following rows; each row here gives the Year BC of the name row and of the last numbered row, as printed. No year is computed from a length.
